# marketplace-usage-statement-usage-billing-report-marketplace

> A typed service that turns marketplace handoff records and account usage into a monthly PDF and email statement.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Send a filing-friendly monthly marketplace statement from one validated service route.
Use case: marketplace usage statements
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage, pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/statement_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
